<documents>
<document id="savings-pockets">
HowˆSavingsˆPocketsˆworkˆSavingsˆPocketsˆareˆseparateˆbalancesˆinsideˆyourˆaccountˆthatˆearnˆinterest.ˆYouˆcanˆhaveˆupˆtoˆ10ˆofˆthem,ˆeachˆwithˆitsˆownˆnameˆandˆgoal.ˆ##ˆCreateˆaˆpocketˆTapˆSavings,ˆthenˆNewˆpocket.ˆNameˆit,ˆsetˆaˆgoalˆifˆyouˆlike,ˆandˆmoveˆmoneyˆin.ˆ##ˆMovingˆmoneyˆMovingˆmoneyˆbetweenˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆandˆyourˆpocketsˆisˆinstantˆandˆfree,ˆeveryˆday.ˆThere'sˆnoˆlimitˆonˆhowˆmanyˆtimesˆyouˆcanˆwithdrawˆfromˆaˆpocket.ˆ##ˆInterestˆAllˆyourˆpocketsˆearnˆtheˆAPYˆforˆyourˆplan:ˆ0.50%ˆonˆBasic,ˆ2.00%ˆonˆPlusˆandˆ3.75%ˆonˆPremium.ˆRatesˆareˆvariable.ˆ##ˆSpendingˆfromˆaˆpocketˆYourˆcardˆspendsˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalance,ˆnotˆfromˆpockets.ˆMoveˆmoneyˆbackˆfirst.ˆ##ˆClosingˆaˆpocketˆTapˆtheˆpocket,ˆthenˆClose.ˆAnyˆmoneyˆandˆaccruedˆinterestˆmoveˆtoˆyourˆmainˆbalance.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="card-damaged">
ReplacingˆaˆdamagedˆcardˆIfˆyourˆcardˆisˆcracked,ˆbent,ˆorˆtheˆchipˆorˆcontactlessˆstopsˆworking,ˆorderˆaˆreplacementˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆorderˆTapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆthenˆReplaceˆcard,ˆthenˆDamaged.ˆConfirmˆyourˆaddressˆandˆpickˆaˆshippingˆspeed.ˆ##ˆYourˆoldˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆWhenˆyouˆreportˆaˆcardˆasˆdamaged,ˆweˆdon'tˆcancelˆit.ˆYouˆcanˆkeepˆusingˆitˆ(ifˆitˆstillˆworks)ˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆreplacement.ˆActivatingˆtheˆnewˆcardˆswitchesˆtheˆoldˆoneˆoff.ˆTheˆnewˆcardˆhasˆtheˆsameˆcardˆnumber,ˆaˆnewˆexpiryˆdateˆandˆaˆnewˆsecurityˆcode.ˆMerchantsˆthatˆstoreˆyourˆcardˆmayˆneedˆtheˆnewˆexpiryˆdate.ˆ##ˆCostˆandˆshippingˆTheˆreplacementˆfeeˆisˆtheˆsameˆasˆforˆaˆlostˆcard:ˆ$5.00ˆonˆBasicˆandˆfreeˆonˆPlusˆandˆPremium.ˆStandardˆshippingˆtakesˆ7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdaysˆandˆcostsˆ$25.00ˆonˆBasicˆandˆPlus.ˆIt'sˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆIfˆyou'reˆnotˆsureˆwhetherˆtheˆcardˆisˆdamagedˆorˆlost,ˆfreezeˆitˆfirst.ˆYouˆcanˆdecideˆafterward.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="account-name-change">
ChangingˆyourˆlegalˆnameˆIfˆyourˆlegalˆnameˆhasˆchanged,ˆforˆexampleˆafterˆmarriageˆorˆdivorce,ˆourˆVerificationˆteamˆcanˆupdateˆit.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyou'llˆneedˆ-ˆAˆphotoˆIDˆinˆyourˆnewˆname,ˆorˆyourˆcurrentˆIDˆplusˆaˆlegalˆdocumentˆshowingˆtheˆchange,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆmarriageˆcertificateˆorˆcourtˆorderˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆrequestˆitˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆaskˆtoˆchangeˆyourˆlegalˆname.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆchangeˆitˆdirectly,ˆbutˆwillˆpassˆtheˆrequestˆtoˆtheˆVerificationˆteamˆandˆtellˆyouˆhowˆtoˆuploadˆtheˆdocuments.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆUpˆtoˆ5ˆbusinessˆdaysˆafterˆweˆreceiveˆyourˆdocuments.ˆ##ˆDateˆofˆbirthˆIfˆyourˆdateˆofˆbirthˆisˆwrongˆonˆyourˆaccount,ˆtheˆsameˆprocessˆapplies.ˆ##ˆYourˆcardˆOnceˆtheˆchangeˆisˆapproved,ˆyouˆcanˆorderˆaˆcardˆinˆyourˆnewˆname.ˆReplacementˆfeesˆfollowˆyourˆplan,ˆbutˆweˆwaiveˆtheˆfeeˆforˆnameˆchanges.ˆ##ˆPreferredˆnameˆYouˆcanˆsetˆaˆpreferredˆfirstˆnameˆforˆtheˆappˆyourselfˆunderˆProfile.ˆItˆdoesn'tˆchangeˆyourˆlegalˆname.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
